title: The Golden Scepter Held Out
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Brave Esther said, "Please fast and pray
With me, three days, my friends.
And then I'll go to see the king,
Whatever way it ends."

[Chorus]
When something scary comes along,
Ask God for a brave heart.
Then do the hard thing anyway,
The Lord will do His part.

[Verse 2]
She wore her royal robe and walked,
Her heart beat fast, so fast.
The king held out his scepter, gold:
"Come close!" Her fear had passed.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; if you feel scared
Tomorrow, or today,
Just pray like Esther, then be brave,
The Lord will lead the way.

[Chorus]
mood: Courage music. A slow, steady heartbeat pulse moves under the voice, a little quick at first like Esther's heart on her walk to the king, then easing as the golden scepter is held out. The chorus swells warm and sure. By the last verse the heartbeat slows and settles low, the fear all gone, and the song rests calm and safe.
